thread:
eric: FYI - saw a small but clear positive delta in invoice-preview for a cohort of US tenants after last night's fanout tweak (~0.45% tokens).

maya: Can you dump a sample request_id we can trace?

eric: sure - request_id=req-cc12 appears twice in the preview sampler with different route_tag headers: `route=primary-7` and `route=primary-7~fallback`. Same payload hash.

omar: That screams fanout mirror semantics. We intended mirrors to be non-billable but proxy currently marks both as billable. Preview aggregates by (tenant, route) in some places so mirrors look like distinct lines.

infra-bot: deploy: fanout-service v3.2 rolled at 2025-02-12T01:15Z (canary->prod). No errors flagged.

maya: Sampler intentionally skips enrichment to stay fast, so ingest only sees what the proxy emits. If proxy doesn't set a canonical_request id consistently, dedupe fails.

eric: Quick repro query I ran: `SELECT request_id, count(*) from preview_events where tenant='tenant:atlas' and ts > now()-interval '1 hour' group by request_id having count(*)>1 limit 5;` returned ~120 hits.

billing-bot: alert: preview-fanout-duplicate-rate tenant_count=8 pct_avg=0.45 severity=low (pager=False)

omar: Short-term fix ideas: 1) Patch ingest to prefer `canonical_request_id` if present and fallback to stripping known suffixes from request_id, 2) add preview-side rule: treat mirrored routes with identical payload hash + request_id as non-billable for 24h (ops toggle).

maya: I can do (1) quickly - small normalization in the ingest proto. Low-risk. Also will add a dashboard card showing `preview_duplicates_by_tenant` to give finance visibility.

eric: I'll add the ops toggle and a metric `mirror_collapses_total` to track how many merges we perform. Also will coordinate a quick finance preview re-run after the hotfix.

infra-bot: noted: fanout semantics RFC assigned to infra-team for longer-term change (make mirrors explicit non-billable).

omar: Medium-term: change watcher to emit mirrors as `mirror=true` and proxy to set `canonical_request_id` consistently. Then consumers can choose to ignore mirrors entirely.

maya: Action list: 1) ingest normalization PR (maya, 1h) 2) preview dashboard + alert (eric, 1h) 3) ops toggle for mirror-collapse (eric, 30m) 4) fanout RFC (infra, next sprint). PRs will be linked here when ready.

eric: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4520 - running canary in us-east now. Will post canary numbers in ~20m.

omar: thanks all. If finance still sees a delta after hotfix we'll dig into sampled payloads and run a replay comparison.

billing-bot: scheduled: finance-sample-dump tenants=affected expires=2025-02-13T02:00:00Z
